1496-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3430-3861-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3861-4348.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3318-7201.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-7201.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2073-6797-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1978-3139-3430-5793.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient and gaining 2 life.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge.
Repeat.

4365-4682-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4365-4682-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Mondrak and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4365-4682-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Chameleon each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-5660-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-2457-4094-5434.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
5686-6972-7607.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3490-3755-4742-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-4742-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4772-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4264-5282-7149.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {2}{G}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Altered Ego dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Altered Ego enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Altered Ego leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Altered Ego from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1409-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

2816-5465-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

1061-1576-7068.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-7068.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-7068.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Wormfang Manta
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1778-4053-4779-6989.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-5663-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

654-3293-5414-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
654-3293-5414-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
654-3293-5414-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-4284.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Clone.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Clone by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3305-3817-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

261-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-2919-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-1796-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1339-2122-2265-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-2265-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

856-2267-5315-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

942-2523-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise the Stouthearted token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

358-1368-1812-4098.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
358-1368-1812-4098.description:
Cast Infernal Plunge for its escape cost by paying {R}, exling three other cards from your graveyard, and sacrificing Stiticher's Supplier.
When Stitcher's Supplier dies, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

224-907-1772-4826.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

985-2471-4574-4659.notablePrerequisites: Zabaz has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
985-2471-4574-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Zabaz, adding {C}{C}.
Zabaz dies, triggering its modular ability, moving its +1/+1 counters onto Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Zabaz on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Zabaz from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Zabaz enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1703-3483-3783-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cromat.
Cromat dies, triggering Minn's second ability and Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Cromat from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Cromat.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cromat's power.
Repeat.

1300-3525-4387-4992.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls at least three lands.
1300-3525-4387-4992.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Carpet of Flowers triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Carpet of Flowers's ability.
Resolve the copy of Carpet of Flowers's ability, targeting an opponent that controls at least three lands, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Carpet of Flowers's ability.
Resolve the copy of Carpet of Flowers's ability, targeting an opponent that controls at least three lands, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3035-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Nadier.
1409-3035-4050.description:
Activate Nadier by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Nadier's leaves-the-battlefield and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability each trigger.
Resolve the Nadier trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Nadier.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elf Warrior tokens, adding {1}{U}.
The tokens leave the battlefield, triggering Nadier's first ability twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Nadier.
Repeat.

1331-1495-3653.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1331-1495-3653.description:
Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Disciple of the Vault triggers, losing target opponent 1 life.
Repeat.

2143-2757.notablePrerequisites: At least one of those sources should be a basic land.
2143-2757.description:
Pay {4} to activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first activated ability, creating two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Use Earthcraft's activated ability on an Eldrazi spawn token, tapping it and untapping a basic land you control.
Float the mana from that basic land and untap it again with the other Eldrazi spawn token.
With {2} floating, sacrifice both of the Eldrazi spawn to make {2} more.
Use the {4} you just made to again use Spawnsire of Ulamog's ability and repeat the loop.
